key.name: short-press-action
key.description: Choose screen locking and blanking, system suspend, or no action.

key.name: resuspend-when-dark
key.summary: Return to standby after a background wake
key.description: On battery, return to standby after a resumed session remains locked and dark for twenty seconds, with no recent input or sleep inhibitor. Visible sessions and accepted power-key or lid wakes retain their normal behavior.
